vulnerability.name: USN-5672-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5672-1 fixed a vulnerability in GMP. This update provides the corresponsing update for Ubuntu 14.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that GMP did not properly manage memory  on 32-bit platforms when processing a specially crafted  input. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause  applications using GMP to crash, resulting in a denial of  service.

statements.status_notes: GMP could be made to crash if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
